senses.en: eyeglasses with two parts, for seeing near and far objects

example.en: Grandfather wears bifocals for reading and driving.
example.zh: 祖父看近处和开车时都戴双光眼镜。

senses.en: not likely to succeed or turn out well

example.en: The project started in unpromising conditions but succeeded in the end.
example.zh: 这个项目在不利条件下起步，但最终成功了。

senses.en: full of bright or varied colors
senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的

example.en: The market was full of colourful fruits and fabrics.
example.zh: 市场里满是色彩鲜艳的水果和布料。

senses.en: lively, interesting, or eventful
senses.zh: 丰富多彩的；生动有趣的

example.en: He led a colourful life as a travelling musician.
example.zh: 他作为流浪音乐家过着丰富多彩的生活。

senses.en: the quality of being productive, especially in producing ideas, results, or crops

example.en: The fruitfulness of their collaboration surprised everyone.
example.zh: 他们合作的丰硕成果令所有人惊讶。

senses.en: smooth and shiny, with an elegant modern shape
senses.zh: 光滑而有光泽的；线条流畅的

example.en: The sports car has a sleek design.
example.zh: 这辆跑车设计线条流畅。

senses.en: looking well-groomed and polished, sometimes in a showy way

example.en: The hotel lobby was full of sleek businesspeople.
example.zh: 酒店大堂里满是光鲜体面的商务人士。

senses.en: covered with a lot of hair

example.en: That breed of dog is large and very hairy.
example.zh: 那个品种的狗体型大且毛很多。

senses.en: (informal) dangerous or frightening

example.en: Driving down that mountain road at night can be pretty hairy.
example.zh: 夜里走那条山路可能相当惊险。

senses.en: usually or under normal conditions

example.en: The library is normally open until six.
example.zh: 图书馆通常开放到六点。

senses.en: Having an uneven or irregular surface; not smooth.

example.en: The table has a rough surface.
example.zh: 这张桌子表面粗糙。

senses.en: Not exact or detailed; approximate.

example.en: Can you give me a rough estimate?
example.zh: 你能给我一个大致的估计吗？

senses.en: Difficult or unpleasant; full of problems.

example.en: He had a rough day at work and went straight to bed.
example.zh: 他这一天上班很不顺心，之后就直接上床睡觉了。

senses.en: An area of long grass beside the fairway on a golf course.
senses.zh: 高尔夫球场球道旁的长草区。

example.en: The ball landed in the rough beside the fairway.
example.zh: 球落在球道旁的长草区。

senses.en: A place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

example.en: The ship entered the port at dawn.
example.zh: 船在黎明时进入港口。

senses.en: A socket or connection point on a computer or device for attaching equipment.

example.en: A USB port lets you connect devices to a computer.
example.zh: USB 端口可用于将设备连接到计算机。

senses.en: To adapt software or a game so it works on a different system.

example.en: The team ported the game to a new platform.
example.zh: 团队将游戏移植到了新平台。

senses.en: a rule or condition that limits what someone can do

example.en: The contract places a limitation on how the data may be used.
example.zh: 合同对数据的使用方式作出了限制。

senses.en: a weakness that prevents something from being fully effective

example.en: She recognizes the limitations of the current method.
example.zh: 她认识到当前方法的局限性。

senses.en: help and advice about what to do

example.en: She sought guidance from her teacher before choosing a career.
example.zh: 她在选择职业之前向老师寻求了指导。

senses.en: the act of showing the way or directing something

example.en: The missile uses satellite guidance to reach its target.
example.zh: 这枚导弹利用卫星导航来抵达目标。

senses.en: having the highest rank or authority
senses.zh: 拥有最高地位或权威的

example.en: The supreme commander has authority over all armed forces.
example.zh: 最高指挥官对所有武装部队拥有权威。

senses.en: highest in degree or quality; ultimate
senses.zh: 程度或品质最高的；至高无上的

example.en: The team displays supreme skill in every match.
example.zh: 这支队伍在每场比赛中都展现出极高的技巧。

senses.en: previously owned or no longer new

example.en: She bought a used car last month.
example.zh: 她上个月买了一辆二手车。

senses.en: familiar with something because you have done or experienced it often; accustomed

example.en: I am used to getting up early.
example.zh: 我习惯早起。

senses.en: used to do something: describing a habit or state that was true in the past but no longer is

example.en: I used to live in London.
example.zh: 我过去住在伦敦。

senses.en: taken advantage of by someone

example.en: He felt used after the meeting.
example.zh: 会议结束后，他觉得自己被利用了。

senses.en: something that is needed or necessary

example.en: A reliable water supply is a basic requirement for every community.
example.zh: 可靠的供水是每个社区的基本需求。

senses.en: an official rule or demand that something must be done

example.en: The job has a language requirement for all applicants.
example.zh: 这份工作对所有申请者都有语言要求。

senses.en: too painful, difficult, or annoying to tolerate or endure
senses.zh: 无法忍受的，难以承受的

example.en: The heat in the small room became unbearable by noon.
example.zh: 到中午时，小房间里热得让人无法忍受。

senses.en: rock or mineral from which metal can be extracted profitably

example.en: The mountain is rich in iron ore.
example.zh: 这座山富含铁矿石。

senses.en: a sudden tearing or bursting open of something

example.en: The rupture of the pipe caused a serious leak.
example.zh: 管道破裂造成了严重的泄漏。

senses.en: a sudden breakdown in a relationship or agreement

example.en: The scandal led to a rupture between the two allies.
example.zh: 这起丑闻导致了两个盟友之间的决裂。

senses.en: to tear or burst suddenly, or to make something do this

example.en: He ruptured a tendon during the match.
example.zh: 他在比赛中撕裂了一条肌腱。

senses.en: shaped like a sphere or ball; round

example.en: The planet Earth is nearly spherical in shape.
example.zh: 地球的形状近似球形。

senses.en: the quality of being complex and detailed, or a complicated detail of something

example.en: The intricacy of the design amazed everyone.
example.zh: 设计的精巧复杂令所有人惊叹。

senses.en: a set of connected rooms, especially in a hotel

example.en: We booked a suite with a sea view for our vacation.
example.zh: 我们度假时订了一间带海景的套房。

senses.en: a set of matching furniture

example.en: They bought a new bedroom suite last month.
example.zh: 他们上个月买了一套新卧室家具。

senses.en: a group of software programs sold or used together

example.en: The office suite includes word processing and spreadsheet programs.
example.zh: 这套办公套件包括文字处理和电子表格程序。

senses.en: a piece of music made of several connected movements

example.en: The orchestra performed a suite by Bach.
example.zh: 管弦乐团演奏了巴赫的一首组曲。

senses.en: to an extreme or exaggerated degree

example.en: The plan was wildly successful.
example.zh: 这个计划极为成功。

senses.en: in an uncontrolled or unrestrained manner

example.en: The crowd cheered wildly when the team scored.
example.zh: 球队得分时，观众疯狂欢呼。

senses.en: a written message sent to someone, usually by post

example.en: She wrote a letter to her grandmother last week.
example.zh: 她上周给祖母写了一封信。

senses.en: a symbol of an alphabet

example.en: The word 'apple' begins with the letter a.
example.zh: apple 这个词以字母 a 开头。

senses.en: the number 50

example.en: My grandmother just turned fifty last week.
example.zh: 我奶奶上周刚满五十岁。

senses.en: the years of one's life from 50 to 59 (the fifties)
senses.zh: 五十多岁；五十至五十九岁

example.en: She is in her fifties but still runs every morning.
example.zh: 她五十多岁了，但仍然每天早上跑步。

senses.en: a banknote worth fifty units of currency

example.en: He paid with a fifty and got some change back.
example.zh: 他用一张五十元纸币付款，找回了一些零钱。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive

example.en: She wore a lovely dress to the party.
example.zh: 她穿了一条漂亮的裙子去参加聚会。

senses.en: very pleasant or enjoyable

example.en: We had a lovely time at the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩度过了愉快的时光。

senses.en: kind and lovable

example.en: He is a lovely person, always ready to help.
example.zh: 他是个可爱的人，总是乐于助人。

senses.en: an expert in collecting and analyzing numerical data

example.en: A statistician analyzed the survey results.
example.zh: 一位统计学家分析了调查结果。

senses.en: arranged in the order of the alphabet

example.en: The names are listed in alphabetical order.
example.zh: 名字按字母顺序排列。

senses.en: relating to an alphabet

example.en: English uses an alphabetical writing system.
example.zh: 英语使用字母文字系统。

senses.en: to make a rough, harsh grating sound; to say in such a voice
senses.zh: 发出刺耳声；用粗哑的声音说

example.en: His voice rasped over the phone.
example.zh: 他在电话里说话声音粗哑刺耳。

senses.en: a rough file with sharp projections used for shaping wood or metal

example.en: He smoothed the edge of the wood with a rasp.
example.zh: 他用粗锉刀把木头的边缘磨平。

senses.en: to scrape or rub something roughly, as with a rasp

example.en: He rasped the rough edge of the plank smooth.
example.zh: 他把木板粗糙的边缘锉平滑了。

senses.en: giving an advantage or priority to someone

example.en: Members get preferential treatment when booking.
example.zh: 会员预订时可享受优先待遇。

senses.en: the state of being famous for something bad

example.en: The town gained notoriety for its unsolved mysteries.
example.zh: 这座小镇因其未解之谜而声名狼藉。

senses.en: lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern

example.en: Voter apathy led to a record-low turnout.
example.zh: 选民的冷漠导致投票率创历史新低。

senses.en: a strong feeling of disgust or horror

example.en: The news of the scandal caused widespread revulsion.
example.zh: 丑闻的消息引起了广泛的反感。

senses.en: used to say what is right, advisable, or expected of someone

example.en: You should get some rest.
example.zh: 你应该休息一下。

senses.en: used to say that something is likely or expected to happen

example.en: The package should arrive tomorrow.
example.zh: 包裹应该明天到。

senses.en: used in a conditional clause to mean if something happens

example.en: Should you need help, please call me.
example.zh: 如果你需要帮助，请打电话给我。

senses.en: to do something or take action

example.en: We must act now to protect the river.
example.zh: 我们必须现在就采取行动保护这条河。

senses.en: a thing that someone does

example.en: Her quiet act of kindness helped everyone.
example.zh: 她默默行善的举动帮助了大家。

senses.en: to perform in a play, film, or show

example.en: He acts in a small theater downtown.
example.zh: 他在市中心一家小剧院表演。

senses.en: a law or formal decision made by an authority

example.en: The new act limits single-use plastics.
example.zh: 这项新法令限制一次性塑料制品。

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in many trucks, buses, and other diesel engines
senses.zh: 柴油；常用于卡车、公交车等柴油发动机的液体燃料

example.en: The truck runs on diesel.
example.zh: 这辆卡车使用柴油。

senses.en: A vehicle or engine that uses diesel fuel.

example.en: She drives a small diesel to work.
example.zh: 她开一辆小型柴油车上班。

senses.en: of a gasoline engine, to keep running briefly after the ignition is switched off
senses.zh: （汽油发动机）关闭点火装置后仍短暂自燃运转

example.en: The old engine dieseled for a few seconds after the key was turned off.
example.zh: 关闭点火开关后，那台旧发动机仍运转了几秒钟。

senses.en: a person legally entitled to receive someone's property, title, or position after that person dies

example.en: His eldest son is the heir to the family business.
example.zh: 他的长子是家族企业的继承人。

senses.en: a senior administrator in charge of a college, faculty, or department at a university

example.en: The dean welcomed the new students at the orientation ceremony.
example.zh: 院长在迎新仪式上欢迎新生。

senses.en: a senior cleric in charge of a cathedral or church chapter

example.en: The dean led the service at the cathedral.
example.zh: 教长在大教堂主持了礼拜仪式。

senses.en: a system of government or organization run by officials and departments, often with many rules

example.en: The permit took months to approve because of the bureaucracy.
example.zh: 由于官僚体制的缘故，许可证花了数月才获批。

senses.en: officials and administrators considered as a group

example.en: The new minister promised to reduce the size of the bureaucracy.
example.zh: 新部长承诺精简官僚机构。

senses.en: annoyingly complicated rules and procedures; red tape

example.en: Applying for the visa involved endless paperwork and bureaucracy.
example.zh: 申请签证要经历没完没了的文书和官僚程序。

senses.en: to make something broader or larger

example.en: The city plans to widen the main road next year.
example.zh: 市政府计划明年拓宽主干道。

senses.en: to become broader or more extensive

example.en: The river widens as it approaches the sea.
example.zh: 河流在接近入海口时变宽。

senses.en: to make someone feel distant or unfriendly, especially a friend or supporter

example.en: His rude comments alienated many of his colleagues.
example.zh: 他无礼的言论使许多同事疏远了他。

senses.en: to persuade gently and patiently

example.en: She coaxed the frightened cat out from under the bed.
example.zh: 她把受惊的猫从床底下哄了出来。

senses.en: easily bent or shaped without breaking

example.en: The leather is soft and pliable after treatment.
example.zh: 皮革经过处理后柔软柔韧。

senses.en: easily influenced or persuaded

example.en: He is too pliable to lead the team on his own.
example.zh: 他太顺从了，难以独自带领团队。

senses.en: (of rain) falling very heavily

example.en: Torrential rain flooded the streets.
example.zh: 暴雨淹没了街道。

senses.en: a sailing boat with a single mast

example.en: They sailed the sloop along the coast all summer.
example.zh: 他们整个夏天都驾驶单桅帆船沿海岸航行。

senses.en: a popular phrase or slogan associated with a group or movement

example.en: Innovation became the catchword of the whole industry.
example.zh: “创新”成了整个行业的流行口号。

senses.en: curving outward like the outside of a circle or sphere

example.en: A convex lens makes objects appear larger.
example.zh: 凸透镜能使物体显得更大。

senses.en: a shout of joy or approval

example.en: Hooray! Our team won the match!
example.zh: 好哇！我们队赢了比赛！

senses.en: a loud cheer of joy or approval

example.en: The crowd gave a loud hooray when the goal was scored.
example.zh: 进球时人群发出了响亮的欢呼。

senses.en: rising or falling at an angle rather than being flat or level

example.en: They walked up a sloping path to the top of the hill.
example.zh: 他们沿着一条倾斜的小路走上山顶。

senses.en: moving or going upward; arranged from lowest to highest

example.en: The files are sorted in ascending order by date.
example.zh: 文件按日期以升序排列。

senses.en: relating to a revival of classical styles in art, architecture or music

example.en: The building has a neoclassical facade.
example.zh: 这座建筑有新古典主义风格的正立面。
